import type { IndexQuote, Article, HotItem, GlanceItem } from './types';

function spark(seed: number, dir: number): number[] {
  const out: number[] = [];
  let v = 100;
  for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
    const n = Math.sin(seed + i * 0.9) * 1.4 + Math.cos(seed * 1.7 + i * 0.5) * 0.9;
    v += n + dir * 0.32;
    out.push(v);
  }
  return out;
}
